name: Saya
source:
Saya is the younger sister of [url=/c25638]Ragna[/url] and [url=/c25639]Jin[/url]. Saya was born with a frail body, and throughout her life, she was bullied by her brother Jin. Her other brother, Ragna, was more caring, spending plenty of time with her. Jin grew jealous of the relationship Ragna and Saya shared, eventually attempting to kill her, two years after she gave Jin the Nox Nyctores, Yukianesa.

Saya, like [url=/c25637]Noel[/url], has atrociously bad cooking skills, being able to turn simple jam into what could only be described as 'black sludge'.
